blocks.text: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. accused China of attempting to silence Philippine officials who speak out against its actions in the West Philippine Sea, describing Beijing’s call to restrain Filipino politicians as a “threat of censorship.” In an interview with Ted Failon and DJ Chacha on True FM, Teodoro said China’s demand could be interpreted […]...
